children.html: Home / Uncategorized / Shop, Save & Win: Eagles Super Bowl Deals

It’s been an incredible season of excitement, energy, and pride as we’ve cheered on the Eagles to victory, week after week! Whether you’ve been wearing your green gear, yelling at the TV, or gathering with friends to support the Birds, we’ve all been in this together. And now, with the Super Bowl coming up on Sunday, February 9th, we’re gearing up to celebrate the Eagles and their journey all season long—and YOU get to join in on the fun with some epic Eagles Super Bowl deals!

Get Ready for a Week of Wins: February 5th – 9th

We’re kicking off the celebration early with a special offer running from Wednesday, February 5th to Sunday, February 9th. Here’s how you can score some amazing savings:

  • Spend $11 – $25: Get 10% off your purchase!
  • Spend $26 – $97: Enjoy 15% off your purchase!
  • Spend $98+: Get 20% off your purchase PLUS a ticket into our giveaway! 

Spend $98 and you’ll get to choose the team you think will win the Super Bowl! After the game, we’ll draw one ticket from the winning team’s entries. Don’t miss out on the chance to score incredible prizes and enjoy the game!

Exciting Giveaway Prizes!

What’s a celebration without awesome prizes? When you spend $98 or more, you’ll be entered into our giveaway for a chance to win:

  • A Kind Tree gym bag (perfect for your next workout or casual outing)
  • Highway 90 Gift Card
  • Brand Swag
  • And so much more!

There’s never been a better time to shop and get rewarded. Not only will you score sweet deals, but you’ll also be in the running for these amazing prizes!

The Big Game = BIGGER Savings!

We’re not stopping there! If the Eagles win on February 9th, we’ll be celebrating with up to 30% off storewide on Monday, February 10th. That’s right—when the Eagles win, YOU win big with incredible discounts across the store.

Get Deals on Your Favorite Brands!

Plus, don’t forget—gameday deals are happening too! We’ve got exclusive discounts on top brands like Wana and Wyld to help you get ready for all the fun. Whether you’re stocking up on your favorite products, getting ready for game day with friends, or treating yourself, we’ve got something special for you!

Join Us in the Celebration!

There’s no better way to keep the winning spirit alive than by being a part of this exciting time with us. Whether you’re celebrating with Eagles gear, shopping for the latest products, or entering our giveaway, there’s plenty to enjoy with our store-wide deals on cannabis products. From your favorite edibles and top-shelf flower to concentrates and accessories, we’ve got something for every Eagles fan. So let’s keep the momentum going, cheer on the Eagles, and get ready for one amazing week of savings, prizes, and fun! Looking for a dispensary near me? Visit us in Marlton, NJ, and take advantage of these unbeatable Super Bowl deals! Plus, shopping with us isn’t just about getting great products—it’s about being part of something bigger. It’s about celebrating with your community, enjoying the thrill of game day, and scoring unbeatable deals while you’re at it. Don’t wait until the last minute—get in on the action early, and let’s make this Super Bowl one to remember!

We’re proud to be your local go-to dispensary in Marlton, NJ, and we can’t wait to cheer on the Eagles with you. Let’s show our support for the Birds and score big together—because when they win, we all win! So why not treat yourself to something special and enjoy the savings at the same time? You deserve it!

Go Birds! 🦅
